issues.desc: CHK-004 context says "the corrected S7 rule" without defining what S7 refers to; a reader cannot understand this rule without separately reading the external execution plan document (docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md). The checklist context should be standalone-readable.
CHK-004 context uses "mde/2 clamped" without expanding the abbreviation MDE (minimum detectable effect). Inferrable for statisticians but not general readers.

background.md Key Insights section references "B-6b39 aligned the plan wording" without a one-sentence explanation of what B-6b39 changed; cross-story references should include a brief description of context on first appearance.
